author: daboyz
quote: I been waiting 7 years for this game gta3 4 5 were a highlight of my childhood, Honestly this game was a little bit of a let down the amount of bugs ive ran into within my first 4hrs of gameplay wasnt goodlooks. I feel like i spent quite a obnoxious doing menial tasks. lets be real this is grand theft sometimes auto. Though I cant sit here and list off all the bad facts the graphics are amazing especially for the software its on. Overall the gameplay loop for the first few hours was just a stale pace which may have been managable if i didnt get clipped into a building because i had a head on wreck with another car, just to be stuck having to load up a old save point, Oh and the store being the 3rd button in the menu is disgusting. Anyways i hope rockstar can cook something up for when pc gets adaption + online.

author: daboyz
quote: Honestly the game is timeless no pun intended although its a remake the amazing graphics and lack of bugs show the love and care that was put into this, the music is still a banger to this day.
